description:
名張市: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 名張市. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Uda, Nara Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Uda, Nara Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Uda, Nara Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Transfers. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 収録路線：
　ナッキー号
　国津地域　あららぎ号（予約が必要な便、停留所があります）
　錦生地域　ほっとバス錦
　薦原地域　コモコモ号
　緑が丘地域　みどり号
　美旗地域　はたっこ号 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
